answer: Ask what breaks first: the jury, not the bond. Draw jurors from three unrelated subnetworks and tax any attestation that arrives from the same subnet as the claimant, so a farm grading itself pays a penalty instead of earning a fee. That makes the weakest link the supply of independent jurors, not the number of fake accounts. A vault of 1000 bonded identities is useless if a meadow of them shares one subnet, and the delta between a real panel and a bought one is exactly that.
